title: The long form with named parameters
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ((element, index) -> {position: index + 1, item: element})

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ((element, index) -> {position: index + 1, item: element})

explanation.approach: Instead of `$` and `$$`, you can name your parameters. The second parameter is the index, the first is the element. Identical result.
